capability: Deterministic Arrhenius rate-constant scaling of two-part epoxy-amine pot-life across temperature. pot_life(T) = pot_life_ref / effective_cure_rate(T, Ea, T_ref). Phase-0 covers pure Arrhenius temperature dependence with published Ea per resin+hardener chemistry family. Phase-1 (BLOCKED operationally) will require 36 owned independently-mixed CRO runs at multi-temperature per Navy prime charter.
population: Twelve well-characterized two-part epoxy-amine coating systems (DGEBA resin paired with hardeners spanning aliphatic polyamine, cycloaliphatic diamine, aromatic amine, amidoamine adduct, and Mannich-base families) with published activation energies from cure kinetics literature and pot-life values from supplier technical data sheets at four temperatures (10, 22.78 = 73°F, 30, 40 °C).
split_methodology: Reference anchor = pot-life at 22.78°C (73°F, coating industry standard per ASTM D2196 / Navy prime charter). Held-out validation at 10, 30, and 40°C using the published Ea from independent kinetics sources (Prime, Kamal-Sourour, Riccardi, Blanco). No fitting is done inside the KPI harness — activation energies are treated as external published constants.
theory: Arrhenius (1889) rate constant coupling with cure kinetics: reaction rate k(T) = A · exp(-Ea/RT). Pot-life inversely proportional to rate constant at fixed reference conversion (typically ~10% for practical gel time): pot_life(T) = pot_life_ref · exp[(Ea/R)·(1/T − 1/T_ref)]. Established for epoxy-amine curing chemistry per Prime R.B. Turi 1997 Chapter 8, Kamal & Sourour Polym Eng Sci 13:59 (1973), Riccardi/Adabbo/Williams J Appl Polym Sci 29:2481 (1984), Blanco et al. Polymer 46:7989 (2005). R = 8.31446261815324 J/(mol·K) CODATA 2018.

metrics.name: arrhenius_pot_life_mape
metrics.note: Mean absolute percent error across 12 systems × 3 held-out temperatures (10, 30, 40°C). Consistent with published Arrhenius accuracy on pot-life scaling for well-characterized epoxy-amine systems in the coating industry.

metrics.name: arrhenius_over_constant_baseline_lift
metrics.note: Baseline predicts constant pot-life at 22.78°C (no temperature correction). Arrhenius reduces MAPE from 95.2% to 14.7%, a 80.5 percentage-point lift. Pot-life varies 5×–10× across the 30-degree temperature range for these systems.

metrics.name: held_out_temperature_extrapolation_mape
metrics.note: Predicting pot-life at 30°C using published Ea and reference pot-life at 22.78°C. Sample is one point per system.

metrics.name: per_system_within_40_percent_rate
metrics.note: Fraction of systems where the worst-case error across ALL held-out temperatures is within ±40%. Observed 12/12 = 100%. The tighter ±20% threshold gives 1/12 systems (mannich-base only); this is the honest practical accuracy of first-principles Arrhenius scaling on pot-life data, which the module's Phase-1 lock (with 36 owned runs) will improve.

metrics.name: applicability_domain_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: effective_cure_rate returns Err(Range) for all 9 red-team probes: NaN temperature, Infinity Ea, NaN reference T, zero/negative T, zero/negative Ea, zero/negative reference T.

metrics.name: authority_lock_preservation_rate
metrics.note: Fixture authority block preserves optimizer_authority=false, constraint_only=true, commercial_product_authority=false, cro_gated_promotion=true. Phase-1 promotion is CRO-gated and remains BLOCKED regardless of this Phase-0 receipt.
